newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Redland no full rebound from Q1.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Redland no full rebound from Q1.

text.p: Redland Plc, the UK building materials group which reported a slump in half year pretax profits on Thursday, said despite expectations of a better second half, year figures will not fully recover from a very poor first quarter.

Robert Napier, chief executive, told Reuters that "We will have a better second half than last year due to cost savings, but it will not make up for the first quarter." For the full year, he added "The damage will be slightly recovered," but not fully.
